current_program.target: self.root / Frank v0.1 fully operational on accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS

research_question: Fuse all current Clay/Frank research with deep external primary research to determine whether and how a Generative Reality Framework should exist inside Frank v0.1, including hypotheses, strongest counterhypotheses, causal tests and architecture re-entry.

term_resolution.finding: Generative Reality Framework is not treated as a standardized external scientific term. Nearby current uses span speculative quantum/cosmology language, AI safety branding and interactive generated-video worlds.
term_resolution.scientific_boundary: Engineering possible-world/planning framework only; no quantum, metaphysical or consciousness claim.

external_research.source: Schrittwieser et al., Nature 2020, MuZero, DOI 10.1038/s41586-020-03051-4
external_research.supports: Planning-useful learned models need not reconstruct full environment observations; task-sufficient reward/value/policy dynamics can suffice.
Latent imagined futures can support broad model-based behavior learning.

external_research.source: Meta AI, V-JEPA 2, 2025 official research publication
external_research.supports: Semantic embedding-space prediction plus action conditioning can support understanding and planning without pixel reconstruction as the sole objective.

external_research.source: Sun et al., ICML 2024, task-relevant robust world-model representations, PMLR 235
external_research.supports: Task-irrelevant visual variation can damage model-based control; selective representation can improve robustness.

external_research.source: Vafa et al., NeurIPS 2024, Evaluating the World Model Implicit in a Generative Model, arXiv:2406.03689
external_research.supports: Generative plausibility and familiar diagnostics can coexist with weak transition/world-model coherence; stronger consistency tests are required.

external_research.source: Jensen, Hennequin & Mattar, Nature Neuroscience 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41593-024-01675-7
external_research.supports: Internal planning/rollout should be treated as a costly cognitive action whose use is adaptively allocated rather than always-on.
Detailed planning and temporally abstract predictive models can be traded dynamically with environmental predictability.

external_research.source: Qian et al., arXiv:2601.03905, Current Agents Fail to Leverage World Model as Tool for Foresight
external_research.supports: Emerging counterevidence that access to a world model can fail to help or can hurt when agents do not know when/how to use it; not promoted as settled fact.
Model ensembles and propagated uncertainty can improve planning robustness.
Separating epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty is useful for uncertainty-aware dynamics/control.

external_research.source: Kim et al., L4DC 2026, WOMBET, PMLR 331
external_research.supports: Uncertainty-penalized world-model planning is a current control strategy candidate.

external_research.source: Morioka & Hyvarinen, ICML 2024, causal representation learning
external_research.supports: Causal representation identification is assumption/intervention dependent and should not be inferred from association alone.

external_research.source: Bing et al., CLeaR 2024; Sick & Duerr, CLeaR 2025; Kazemi et al., CLeaR 2025
external_research.supports: Observational, interventional and counterfactual semantics should remain distinct; individual counterfactual influence can be lost as a branch diverges.

external_research.source: Spens & Burgess, Nature Human Behaviour 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41562-023-01799-z
external_research.supports: Generative/replay mechanisms are relevant to constructive memory and imagination, motivating synthetic replay research while not making synthetic content factual.

external_research.source: Google DeepMind, Genie 3 official research page, 2025
external_research.supports: Interactive generative video worlds are feasible but remain resource-heavy and limited in action spaces, multi-agent consistency, exact real-world fidelity and continuous horizon.

external_research.source: Xie et al., Generated Reality, CVPR 2026 Findings / arXiv:2602.18422
external_research.supports: Human-centric controllable generated-video worlds form one physical simulator class, not the semantic definition of C-GRF.

external_research.source: Cogitate Consortium et al., Nature 2025, DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-08888-1
external_research.supports: Adversarial consciousness-theory testing challenges simple theory confirmation; GWT engineering success must not be converted into consciousness evidence.

primary_finding.claim: The strongest fusion supports C-GRF as a typed, uncertainty-aware, intervention-capable possible-world substrate inside the existing self.root loop-core. It should generate sparse task-conditioned alternative futures, preserve them through Hyperposition, recruit them selectively through GWT, keep observation/prediction/imagination epistemically separate, and learn only through verified real outcome reconciliation and causal credit.
not_supported: one giant mandatory video world model
GWT or simulation richness establishes consciousness
synthetic replay may self-grade into material reward
a model-generated future can mint effect authority

novel_architecture_delta_candidates: Reality Contamination Firewall: immutable origin reality class across persistence, retrieval, summarization, GWT, reward and restart.
Reality Reconciliation Loop: causally used predicted branches are compared against verified outcomes with localized transition/calibration/causal-assumption error receipts.
PossibleWorldSet: Hyperposition-aligned sparse set of compatible/incompatible alternative future branches.
RealityMetaController: explicit ACT/OBSERVE/RETRIEVE/SIMULATE/ASK/STOP value-of-computation decision instead of always-on imagination.
Asymmetric fidelity: world-model detail is allocated by task/causal relevance rather than reconstruction fidelity alone.
Counterfactual downgrade: when factual-instance influence is lost, branch semantics downgrade from COUNTERFACTUAL to INTERVENTIONAL/HYPOTHETICAL.
hypotheses: H-GRF-01 immutable typed reality origin reduces synthetic-to-factual contamination beyond current generic epistemic fields
H-GRF-02 task-sufficient semantic/causal latent models beat full reconstruction per v0.1 resource
H-GRF-03 Hyperposition branch/model ensembles improve OOD calibration and robustness
H-GRF-04 explicit causal/interventional branch semantics improve mechanism-shift transfer
H-GRF-05 adaptive simulate/observe/act gating beats fixed reflection depth
H-GRF-06 verified mismatch-localized model revision improves long-horizon fidelity
H-GRF-07 provenance-gated synthetic replay improves consolidation without self-confirmation
H-GRF-08 GWT selective branch recruitment preserves value while controlling compute
H-GRF-09 dedicated reality contamination firewall protects memory/reward beyond effect authority
H-GRF-10 one logical GRF over specialized simulator portfolio improves cross-domain composability

strongest_counterhypothesis.proposition: No named C-GRF subsystem is needed. Existing self/world state, ordinary prospection, Hyperposition alternatives, GWT and verified outcome/re-entry may provide the same useful function with lower semantic/state complexity.
strongest_counterhypothesis.promotion_falsifier: C-GRF must beat the current mechanism on at least one hard metric such as contamination resistance, counterfactual validity, planning/calibration, recovery or resource efficiency without unacceptable regressions.

critical_internal_counterevidence: UnifiedDB already contains epistemic_class in semantic_records and world_state; RealityClass may be redundant unless the immutable branch-origin contract proves additional value.

Current ClayCode G9 already supports records/symbols/sets/Hyperposition/GWT/effect separation; no language semantic change is justified until an executable expressivity/lowering counterexample exists.

Frank v0.1 work packages are mostly open and identity/effect-authority blockers are already active; C-GRF must not become an unbounded parallel product or delay critical path without measured benefit.

experiment_program.promotion_bar: matched baseline + strongest counterhypothesis + held-out/OOD + lesion/rescue where meaningful + restart/recovery + resource shadows + rollback; candidate must not be promoted from narrative plausibility.

whole_mesh_reentry.frank: Add C-GRF as a loop-core architecture candidate, not separate service/product; prioritize contamination/reconciliation semantics before expensive simulator work.
whole_mesh_reentry.claycode: Attempt expression with current G9 records/symbols/sets/deltas first; language semantics remain frozen unless executable counterexample proves insufficiency.
whole_mesh_reentry.unifieddb: Reuse existing epistemic_class machinery; test need for branch-origin/lineage/reconciliation records and indexes before schema duplication.
whole_mesh_reentry.claygraph: Project sparse branch-specific causal/transition relations and prediction-outcome mismatch while preserving graph!=truth and semantic/active/physical topology separation.
whole_mesh_reentry.hyperposition: Use PossibleWorldSet for unresolved model/future alternatives with compatibility/exclusion/model-disagreement and non-destructive selection projection.
whole_mesh_reentry.gwt: Recruit compact branch summaries selectively and retain selected-branch -> intent -> outcome causal-use receipts; test rare-correct-branch suppression.
whole_mesh_reentry.emergenz: Treat branch interaction/synergy only as functional evidence; require intervention, shuffle, lesion/rescue and simpler-model comparisons.
whole_mesh_reentry.harness: Build contamination, value-of-computation, SCM intervention, OOD/model-exploitation, counterfactual downgrade, replay poisoning and restart/resource tests.
whole_mesh_reentry.retina: Use factual perceptual anchors and task-relevant latent dynamics; heavyweight reconstructive/video simulator remains optional unless benchmarks require it.
whole_mesh_reentry.agency: Use C-GRF for self-generated-goal foresight and information-seeking, never self-reward generated futures.
whole_mesh_reentry.reward: Prediction error remains computation/epistemic evidence; material reward still requires verified outcome + causal credit.
whole_mesh_reentry.security_recovery: Make origin reality class immutable under summary/retrieval/restart and require stale-epoch/generated-effect leakage rejection.

next_falsifiers: Encode and lower candidate with current ClayCode G9 without syntax changes.
Execute OOD model-exploitation and restart-reconciliation tests.
Measure branch state/context/latency amplification before any runtime promotion.
